prompt: BUG-074: developer switches must be read with kke::dev::env(name) from "kke/DevTools.h" (it returns the variable in developer builds and nullptr in shipping builds, so players can't use them), not std::getenv. Net.cpp in climb_race already does it: `if (const char* wait = kke::dev::env("KKE_CLIMB_WAIT")) ...`. In games/climb_race/ClimbRaceModule.cpp replace the three std::getenv calls with kke::dev::env: the one in envFloat(), the one in envOn(), and `std::getenv("KKE_CLIMB_INTRO")`. Add `#include "kke/DevTools.h"` next to the file's other "kke/..." includes, in alphabetical order. Keep <cstdlib> (std::atof still needs it). Change nothing else.
